title: Derived reduction modulo varpi^n is left adjoint to restriction of scalars
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ and a scheme $Y$. Use the small pro-etale site $\mathcal C=Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with its small skeleton and module universe [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $m\geq1$ put $A_{E,m}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ and let $(A_{E,m})_Y$ be its constant sheaf of rings. Define $R=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_{m\geq1}(A_{E,m})_Y$, with transition maps induced by the quotient maps and limit projections $\pi_m$ [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit], and put $S=(A_{E,n})_Y$. Write $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ and $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})=\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ denote their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\operatorname{Res}_n:\operatorname{Mod}(S)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ be restriction of scalars along the reduction projection $a=\pi_n:R\to S$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Since restriction of scalars leaves the underlying abelian sheaf unchanged and preserves kernels and cokernels [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $\operatorname{Res}_n$ is exact; hence, applying it termwise defines a triangulated functor $\operatorname{Res}_n:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$. Let $-\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ be the derived tensor product with $(A_{E,n})_Y$ over $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$, computed with K-flat resolutions [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Then $-\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$ is left adjoint to $\operatorname{Res}_n$: there are bijections

$$
 \Hom_{D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})}\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n},M\bigr)
 \cong
 \Hom_{D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)}\bigl(K,\operatorname{Res}_nM\bigr),
$$

natural in $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and $M\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$, whose unit is the map $K\to\operatorname{Res}_n(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$ induced by $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\to(A_{E,n})_Y$.

proof.text: For the completed coefficient projection, the existing same-site tensor/restriction construction gives the underived adjunction and its normalized unit. The exactness proof uses the underlying abelian-sheaf forgetful functors and reflection of finite limits and colimits.

For exact restriction R, every homotopy object K has an essentially constant ind diagram after the denominator-under construction. Build the filtered category explicitly from the right-fraction calculus and use the exact functor to show that every map out of the identity denominator is sent to an isomorphism in the derived category; the resulting cocone is the required essential-constancy witness.

source.place: right-fraction localization and exact functor derived factorization

proof.text: For the left-derived comparison, use the resolving-class essential-constancy theorem on the class of homotopy objects where the chosen counit is invertible. K-flat resolutions supply this class and counit naturality proves closure under the relevant quasi-isomorphisms, giving the required essentially constant pro diagrams.

Apply the existing compatibility theorem for derived adjunctions to the homotopy adjunction, the two essential-constancy witnesses, the chosen derived extension and exact derived restriction, and their comparison maps. It produces the required derived adjunction and the canonical hom-equivalence formula.

Specialize the compatibility formula to the identity homotopy morphism. Naturality of the derived hom-equivalence identifies the comparison with the derived unit followed by the image of the underived counit. Reassociate and cancel the inverse/forward factorization isomorphisms to obtain the displayed unit equation.
